method: Media files inventoried and representative 24-frame contact sheets inspected in tmp/flow-review. All are 1280x720, 24fps old drafts. The prior company-film evidence record does not resolve rights, geography, equipment or model-output QA.

results.finding: Dark globe, space or fantastic satellite imagery; old generated style specifically disfavored by current user direction.
Abstract floating panels and particles do not read as actual product, science or physical analysis.
Static fish-farm-style water rectangle with no persuasive detection or segmentation action.
Central boat with stylized sonar fan; camera and physical subject mostly static. Could be a technical concept still, but does not meet active-motion 1080p hero/main film gate.
Underwater is empty, lab is a largely static bench; no observation or analysis action.
Generated small surface vehicle has questionable brand lettering and only slight motion; no supported GeoSR ownership or sufficient real survey activity.

conclusion: No old draft is meeting-ready under the current 1080p, dynamic documentary, physical plausibility and provenance criteria. Do not pad the hero reel with these files. Preserve them as historical drafts only.
